item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00213","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C01","C13","C12"],"selected_candidate_label":"C01","confidence":0.76,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C01 plausibly supplied a material template for the child’s household-goods transportation provisions. It uses the same distinctive bundle of covered services—transportation, packing, crating, drayage, unpacking, and temporary storage—and the same weight-based reimbursement machinery. The child substantially expands and adapts that machinery from civilian transfers to members of the uniformed services, including prescribed weight limits, storage, excess costs, and bills of lading. C13 is related to transportation allowances for nearly the same enumerated services but concerns passenger travel and lacks the household-goods machinery. C12 is another detailed uniformed-services allowance regulation, but its clothing subject and payment structure are materially different.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Shipment of household goods.-Transportation, including packing, crating, drayage (at point of shipment and at destination), temporary storage, and unpacking, at Government expense","parent_excerpt":"actual expenses of transportation, packing, crating, drayage, and unpacking of household goods and personal effects","explanation":"This is a distinctive, nearly identical enumeration of the component services treated as household-goods transportation."},{"child_excerpt":"Household goods ... not in excess of the weight limits in pounds herein prescribed, may be shipped at government expense","parent_excerpt":"The amount payable shall be the product of the applicable rate and the net weight of household goods and personal effects actually shipped ... within the weight limitation","explanation":"Both organize the entitlement around the net weight actually shipped and a prescribed maximum weight."},{"child_excerpt":"Vouchers covering payment of commercial storage at Government expense will be supported by a certificate","parent_excerpt":"Any claim for reimbursement for temporary storage shall be supported by the original or certified copy of the receipted warehouse bill.","explanation":"Both pair temporary-storage reimbursement with documentary support, reinforcing shared administrative machinery beyond the general topic."}]}
